paper_metadata.title: Predicting creep-fatigue and thermomechanical fatigue life of Ni-base superalloys using a probabilistic physics-guided neural network

evidence.quote: for a single class of materials, in this case, directionally-solidified and single-crystal Ni-base superalloys with similar chemistries and heat treatments typically used for gas turbine blades and vanes.

machine_learning_models.name: probabilistic physics-guided neural network (PPgNN)
machine_learning_models.task: predict cycles to failure under thermomechanical fatigue and creep-fatigue test conditions
machine_learning_models.dataset: fatigue data data-mined from multiple sources in the open literature for directionally-solidified and single-crystal Ni-base superalloys (Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.7476962)

evidence.quote: This paper demonstrates the use of a probabilistic physics-guided neural network (PPgNN) for developing a robust model to predict the cycles to failure under an extraordinary wide range of thermomechanical fatigue and creep-fatigue test conditions.
The model captures the essential life behaviors typically observed such as a cross-over in IP and OP TMF, reduced life with increasing temperature or added dwells
for a single class of materials, in this case, directionally-solidified and single-crystal Ni-base superalloys
